source.title: Duskwood Mission XI: Cold Iron Ore
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove and collect Cold Iron Ore from within the Nightmare Incursions. We can harness its magic to reverse the damage. You will need the assistance of a miner.
source.objective: Gather 10 Cold Iron Ore in the Duskwood Nightmare Incursions and return to Field Captain Palandar.
source.progress: You have the Cold Iron Ore?
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
